name: Aoyama Nagisa
source:
A classmate of Yuuta. She is the president and leader of the class. She always interrupts Yuuta's activities. 

Her criticism of Yuuta is even stronger than it was three years ago. Perhaps she has special feelings for Yuuta?

Although she insists it was just a coincidence, she joined the soccer club after Yuuta and is now the manager.

In many ways, she is more powerful than in the previous works, which was pure and innocent. As she says, "When I do it, I do it!"

The love triangle (?) with Riko is also ongoing.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/yara_change/chara.html]official site[/url]]
